notes: Product-scoped candidate for consumer Wirex X-Accounts. Current first-party terms provide unusually clear title-transfer language: crypto-assets deposited into an X-Account become owned by Wirex and may be used, held or managed at its discretion; the account is not a checking, savings, bank or deposit account and lacks government-backed deposit protection. Flexible and Fixed products have different rate and withdrawal mechanics. UK regulatory material identifies X-Accounts as a crypto feature not regulated by the FCA; that statement is jurisdiction-specific and must not be generalized worldwide. An authoritative first-party original X-Accounts launch date was not established in this review, so canonical launch_date should remain null unless separately verified. Wirex Business Yield is a separate business product and is outside this candidate identity.
